annotation_policy: Explicit LLM-assisted source review. Existing reviewed-page negatives retained; added positive-only groups do not make unreviewed lines negative. No claim of human-verified gold or complete-document coverage.
test: 32 full pages: two four-page contiguous windows from each of four fresh WFP reports. Not a template-family holdout. Frozen before fitting.
selection: Highest validation exact heading-group plus level F1; ties prefer simpler variant. Test scores are read after selection.
historical_benchmark: Diagnostic only: its errors informed this method. No training labels from those PDFs.
cost: CPU inference, no API calls. Annotation labour and machine ownership excluded from runtime; not zero total cost.
deferred: Further training annotation toward 1000-2000 groups and independently reviewed complete reports remain follow-up work.
source_exclusion: Catalogue 962 GAFSP was removed before fitting because it is not a WFP evaluation; replaced by WFP Niger report 321.
